title: Read logical payloads, persisted records and declared relationships
preconditions: Disposable format-2 Saga using the PDF inventory fixture: implemented PDF report held by Record store, proposed JSON PDF job held by Job queue, report-to-job production relationship, application ERD, and pdf-jobs overlay; the reporting ERD also includes a job association with owner 0..many and destination unknown.

steps.action: Open PDF report details and inspect purpose, fields, keys and holder.
steps.expected_result: The report is a persisted record, JobID is an authored foreign key note rather than an enforced constraint, and Record store is separately identified as the holding resource.

steps.action: Open the pinned PDF job from the drawer and inspect its holder and proposal state.
steps.expected_result: The code-free proposal remains visible; its pinned drawer says the holder carries the job until a worker consumes it.

steps.action: Inspect the application production relationship and reporting association, then follow each related entity link.
steps.expected_result: Production flows from job to report; association reports 0..many and unknown without guessing; related definitions open at their declared pins.
